title: GIS data description card
description: Output of `gis.py describe <path> --json` (gis-kit): metadata read from headers and system tables only; no features or pixels are read. Readers ignore unknown fields.

revision.description: Identity of the described file, so readers can tell when a card is stale.

layers.description: Vector layers (kind=vector), at most `layer_limit` of them.

feature_count.description: null when the driver cannot count without scanning.

field_types_sampled_bytes.description: Only for CSV: field types are inferred from this many leading bytes of the file, so a later row can disagree.

decoded_bytes.description: width x height x the sum of band dtype sizes: all bands decoded in their own dtypes. Optional; working copies (e.g. float64) are larger.

nodata.description: Per band: a number, "nan" for a NaN NoData, or null when unset.

transform.description: Affine [a, b, c, d, e, f]: x = a*col + b*row + c, y = d*col + e*row + f, at the outer corner of the pixel. null when the raster has none; then resolution and extent are null too.

world_file.description: Name of the sidecar the affine came from (.jgw, .pgw, .tfw, .wld, ...), or null.

warnings.description: Deterministic facts that are easy to miss; never advice.

id.description: Authority code such as EPSG:4490, or null when none is identified.

horizontal.description: Only when id is null: an EPSG inferred for the horizontal part (a compound CRS's projected or geographic part, or the CRS itself), kept only when its projection parameters and geodetic CRS match.

vertical.description: Name of the vertical part of a compound CRS, or null.

extent.description: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in the layer's own CRS, or null.
